proposed_facts.reason: CardQueueEntry has six fields: type, context, three operation words and callback; dispatcher consumes the 32-entry ring.
Interrupt masking ends before insertion; producer advances before sizeof(CardCmd) memcpy. Deferred commands dereference borrowed state and payload pointers.
Type13 constructor initializes the listed fields but not x8/xC; dispatch reads a sector and completion updates physical-slot maps.
Prefix sums single-copy subfile block counts; reconciliation subtracts it from logical identifiers rather than physical offsets.
Arithmetic reads geometry and payload sizes, not redundancy modes; map consumers establish the logical identifier domain.
Only index==0 and index>=9 return early. Negative indices reach the initial contribution and skip the loop.
Read-only query preserves the actual negative-input branch and performs no map lookup or redundancy allocation.
Reconciliation resolves each logical interval into selected physical slots, supporting the qualified container-addressing explanation.
Offset helper performs sector arithmetic on the supplied physical slot; the scan constructor uses it directly.
The helper reads x8/x24 and returns a sector multiple. x170 is separately indexed by physical slot.
Read orchestration constructs a logical-to-physical map before invoking physical offset/read helpers.
Verifier distinguishes physical slot from expected logical identifier, checks decoded ID/sequence/payload, and returns early for size zero.
Writer tests physical block_idx==0, requires logical ID zero there, preserves the containing sector, and leaves map updates to callers.
Reconciliation uses inclusive x460 and nine subfiles; absent duplicate capacity can be skipped without changing the return status.
Source confirms generation selection, mode-dependent invalidation, error precedence, immediate disposal-map mutation, no destination reservation and no local rollback.
Maintenance stages types12/17 and publishes context type5 with xC zero; worker passes xC as callback ID and the separate global as result.
Block readers validate before optional copying; wrapper advances destination slices without a null guard. Null is not a clear-only mode.
Secondary shortage records -258 but continues to queued context publication. Preliminary slot-zero enqueue is ignored; checked failures rewind.
Normal updater fills replacement slots from alternates/free slots and then current slots, so prior-generation preservation is conditional.
Generation-based CARD update mapping fits canonical dispatch and replacement behavior without claiming unconditional copy-on-write recovery.
Capacity failure lacks queued rewind, preliminary preservation admission is ignored, and queued completion uses active context type3.
Recovery's synchronous cleanup branch returns after its first remaining-secondary disposal, before rewriting; queued control flow continues.
Map construction, borrowed payload verification, secondary disposal and context type4 publication match the corrected data flow and early-return exception.
Integer-carried payload/callback values have the stated effective uses; zero can be the successful first-disposal result rather than a completed update.
Recovery role is supported, while the synchronous early return prevents an unconditional coherent-replacement guarantee.
Cleanup invalidates one map and closes only on negative disposal result before unconditional return; remaining paths and ignored preliminary enqueue are preserved.
Presentation writer name describes canonical comments/banner/icon/digest serialization and removes unsupported Snapshot specificity.
Writer refreshes descriptor-derived extent and serializes presentation plus digest; create stages logical payload population separately.
arg1 supplies format-sized banner bytes and arg2 remaining presentation bytes; queued type9/type10 consumers retain these source pointers.
CARD presentation persistence is independently supported by sizing and serialization, without inferring snapshot semantics from a rendered helper name.
Queued final-sector initialization clears the whole buffer; noninitializing mode queues negative-selector preservation read. Literal synchronous conditions and lack of local rollback match source.
Population order, spare policies, full-capacity source reads, ignored initial admission and synchronous slot-zero map/error exceptions are all present.
Create's integer-carried arguments flow to filename and presentation source-pointer consumers; completion context supplies callback ID zero.
Create separately stages type7 allocation, presentation writing, x70 logical payload population and type8 status; pointer lifetimes remain borrowed.
UpdatePresentationAsync distinguishes this presentation/status-only transaction from logical-subfile updates.
Transaction invokes noninitializing presentation writing and type8 status, not logical payload population.
Queue rewind does not undo x24 refresh; context xC zero is callback ID, not shared result.
Type11 dispatch calls CARDReadAsync and completion extracts presentation outputs, supporting ReadPresentationAsync.
Setup refreshes x24, queues presentation-sector reads, rolls back failed construction and publishes context type5 with optional output words.
Producer-to-callback tracing establishes nullable comments/banner/icon output pointers despite s32 ABI spelling; completion uses ID zero.
Type11 fields carry sector index and three outputs; completion copies bytes and checks the trailing digest. Command copies do not own output storage.
The operation loads and validates presentation metadata, not a versioned-header write or all logical save components.
x24 refresh precedes checkpoint, rollback only clears appended queue entries, and callback result comes from hsd_804D7988.
Callback preserves type13 map-only failure handling, negative-selector close anomaly, output-before-digest timing and unconditional accepted-path retirement.
Mode guard, numeric mismatch statuses, written-slot map changes, captured fileNo loop and callback epilogue all match canonical branches.
Sizing reads compact banner/icon descriptor offsets and adds fixed comments length; header definition separates x370, x3B0 and digest storage.
Global initializer resets queue cursors/types/result and mode; InitQueues resolves the rendered collision without claiming historical spelling.
Per-object initializer clears CardState and installs channel/geometry/work buffer; InitState accurately distinguishes its scope.
Open retries only -1; fileNo loop tests captured tmp; negative branch does not close; close result is ignored before unmasked request-ring admission.
